name: B10-0453/2025 (S&D) – Situation in Belarus, five years after the fraudulent presidential elections
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Belarus, five years after the fraudulent presidential elections
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is setting out its position and asking the European Union to act on Belarus. It calls for an end to the crackdown on the Belarusian people and for all political prisoners to be freed. It asks for stronger sanctions on those responsible for repression and for Belarus's support of Russia's war in Ukraine. It also says the EU does not recognise Lukashenka as Belarus's legitimate president.

- The EU is asked to widen sanctions on officials and judges behind the repression.
- Political prisoners and their families are the main people affected.
- Next, EU institutions and member states decide whether to act on these calls.
